title: Bunnies & Brews: Yoga at Hourglass Brewing
description: Enjoy a relaxing morning of yoga surrounded by adoptable bunnies, followed by food and craft beer discounts.
long_description:
Enjoy a relaxing morning of yoga surrounded by adoptable bunnies, followed by food and craft beer discounts.

About this Event

Your ticket includes the yoga session with the bunnies, plus exclusive discounts on "hoppy" Hourglass beers right after class. Come enjoy discount on Hourglass beers and a specialty food truck with brunch items only available for this event!
Event Details:
Date: Sunday, October 18Time: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Yoga starts promptly at 10:00 AM)Location: Hourglass Brewing (District Location: 2500 Curry Ford Rd Orlando, FL 32806What to bring: A yoga mat, a water bottle, and your phone for photos.Drink specials & discounts on Hourglass Beers!Spaces are limited to keep the environment safe and comfortable for both guests and bunnies. Grab your spot early!
